errors.message: System pnpm shim points to a missing Corepack module; Supabase CLI is not globally installed.
errors.resolution: Prepend the bundled override, fallback and Node directories to PATH so nested package scripts also resolve the bundled pnpm.

errors.message: Supabase CLI 2.109 rejected deprecated [inbucket] and the obsolete auth.rate_limit.verify key.
errors.resolution: Use [local_smtp] and only current rate-limit keys.

errors.message: Docker CLI is installed but the Docker Desktop daemon is not running, so the local Supabase stack cannot start yet.
errors.resolution: Keep the project-local CLI/config/tests ready; do not start a system-level daemon without explicit user authority. Run live DB checks when Docker Desktop is available.
